description:
@Brett.tech_ shows how easy it is to set timers while cooking with your Apple Watch, completely hands free. 🍳⏲️ Here’s how he does it ⬇️

• Open Settings and tap Watch App 
• Then tap Siri and set Listen for to “Off”  
• Now, just raise your hand and start talking

Created by @brett.tech_. Shared by Apple.
